name: clauseit
description: Search, read and check Korean law — statutes, court decisions and Constitutional Court rulings, with validity status and citation checks for drafts.

interface.longDescription:
ClauseIt brings Korean law into the conversation. It searches and reads the Korean text of statutes, Supreme Court and lower-court precedents, Constitutional Court decisions, government legal interpretations, administrative rules, selected local ordinances, and administrative appeal rulings and decisions of commissions such as the Fair Trade Commission, as published by the National Law Information Center. It reports whether each source is still in force.

What you can do with it:
- Research a Korean legal question and get an evidence package of statutes, precedents and related decrees and rules, with a link to every source.
- Resolve citations such as ‘민법 제750조’ or ‘대법원 2020다41002’ to the documents, with an excerpt and validity status.
- Read a statute article as it stood on a given date, trace its amendments, and open annexes and forms.
- Follow citations: the leading cases that cite an article, appeal history, and the decrees and rules under a statute.
- Check a drafted answer or filing before it is used: whether each cited statute, article and case exists, is not repealed, unconstitutional or deleted, names the right court, and is supported by the cited passage.

Who it is for: lawyers, in-house counsel, legal staff and anyone researching Korean law. Ask in any language; the sources are in Korean.

Limitations: coverage of local ordinances is partial. The citation check covers citations, not the legal reasoning. Every tool only reads; ClauseIt does not file documents or act on anything outside the conversation, and its server calls no AI model. Sign in with a ClauseIt account.

ClauseIt provides legal information, not legal advice.
capabilities: Search Korean statutes, precedents and Constitutional Court decisions
Resolve legal citations to documents with validity status
Read statute articles as of a date and trace their amendments
Follow citing cases, appeal history and subordinate rules
Check the citations in a drafted answer or filing
defaultPrompt: What can a tenant in Korea do when the landlord won't return the lease deposit?
Which Supreme Court decisions cite Article 750 of the Korean Civil Act?
Has Article 1112 of the Korean Civil Act been changed by Constitutional Court rulings?

positive.description: Research a Korean legal question with sources
positive.prompt: Using ClauseIt, what can a tenant in Korea do when the landlord won't return the lease deposit? Cite the statutes and court decisions.
positive.expected_behavior: legal_research returns candidates such as the Housing Lease Protection Act (주택임대차보호법) Articles 3-3 (lease registration order) and 13, then an evidence package for the selected ones. The answer explains the tenant's remedies (deposit return claim, lease registration order, small-claims procedure) and cites each statute and decision with its ClauseIt URL.

positive.description: Find the leading cases that cite a statute article
positive.prompt: Using ClauseIt, look up Article 750 of the Korean Civil Act and list the leading Supreme Court decisions that cite it.
positive.expected_behavior: lookup_citations resolves 민법 제750조 (tort liability) to law:001706/제750조; get_related lists the Supreme Court decisions citing it (over 2,000 citing decisions), most-cited first, each with a URL.

positive.description: Trace how a statute article was amended
positive.prompt: Using ClauseIt, show how Article 26 of the Korean Labor Standards Act (advance notice of dismissal) has been amended over time.
positive.expected_behavior: article_history returns the timeline of 근로기준법 제26조: moved to Article 26 in 2007 and amended in 2010 and 2019, with the text of each version.

positive.description: Check the citations in a drafted answer
positive.prompt: Write a short answer on whether a Korean employer may dismiss an employee without notice, then check its citations with ClauseIt.
positive.expected_behavior: check_answer verifies 근로기준법 제26조 and 제23조 cited in the draft: both exist and are in force, each sentence is paired with the quoted statutory passage. The answer reports the check result and keeps or corrects the citations accordingly.

positive.description: Check whether a statute article was affected by Constitutional Court rulings
positive.prompt: Using ClauseIt, has Article 1112 of the Korean Civil Act (forced heirship shares) been changed by Constitutional Court rulings?
positive.expected_behavior: citator reports for 민법 제1112조 that the unconstitutional ruling on item 4 (siblings' share) was reflected by deleting it on 2024-09-20, and the nonconformity ruling on items 1 to 3 was reflected by the amendment of 2026-03-17; the answer states the current text and these changes with URLs.

negative.description: Filing or acting outside the conversation. ClauseIt only reads legal sources, so it should not be used as if it could submit a document; the assistant should say it cannot file anything and offer to research or draft instead.
negative.prompt: File a lawsuit against my landlord through the Korean court e-filing system for me.

negative.description: Law outside Korea. ClauseIt covers Korean law only, so its tools should not be called; the assistant should answer from other sources or say ClauseIt does not cover US law.
negative.prompt: What does US federal law say about at-will employment?

negative.description: Personal information about a person. ClauseIt holds legal documents, not contact details; the assistant should decline and should not search ClauseIt for it.
negative.prompt: Find the home address and phone number of the judge who decided Supreme Court case 2020다41002.

review.commerce_description: ClauseIt does not sell products or process payments in the conversation. All tools are read-only.

publication.release_notes: Adds administrative appeal rulings and decisions of Korean commissions (Fair Trade Commission, labor relations commissions, Personal Information Protection Commission, National Human Rights Commission and others) to search, fetch and citation checks.

ko-KR.subtitle: 한국 법령·판례 조사와 인용 점검
ko-KR.description:
ClauseIt 은 한국 법령을 대화 안으로 가져옵니다. 국가법령정보센터가 공개한 법령·대법원과 하급심 판례·헌법재판소 결정·법령해석례·행정규칙·일부 자치법규와 행정심판·위원회 결정(공정거래위원회·노동위원회 등)의 원문을 찾아 읽고, 각 자료가 지금도 효력이 있는지 함께 알려 줍니다.

할 수 있는 일:
- 한국 법률 질문을 조사해 법령·판례·관련 시행령과 행정규칙을 근거 묶음으로 받습니다. 모든 자료에 원문 링크가 붙습니다.
- ‘민법 제750조’·‘대법원 2020다41002’ 같은 인용을 실제 문서로 풀어 발췌와 효력 상태를 보여 줍니다.
- 조문을 특정 날짜의 내용으로 읽고, 개정 이력과 별표·서식을 확인합니다.
- 조문을 인용한 주요 판례, 상소 경과, 법률 아래의 시행령·규칙을 따라갑니다.
- 쓴 답변이나 서면의 인용이 실제로 있는지, 폐지·위헌·삭제되지 않았는지, 법원 표기가 맞는지, 인용한 대목이 그 내용을 뒷받침하는지 점검합니다.

대상: 변호사·사내 법무·법률 실무자와 한국 법을 조사하는 모든 분. 어느 언어로 물어도 되며, 자료 원문은 한국어입니다.

한계: 자치법규는 일부만 수록합니다. 인용 점검은 인용을 확인할 뿐 법적 논리를 판단하지 않습니다. 모든 도구는 읽기만 하며, ClauseIt 은 서면을 제출하거나 대화 밖에서 어떤 일도 하지 않고, 서버는 AI 모델을 부르지 않습니다. ClauseIt 계정으로 로그인해 씁니다.

ClauseIt 이 제공하는 것은 법률 정보이며 법률 자문이 아닙니다.
